verdict.rationale: The CLI reference has an option to 'Print TTFT and throughput statistics after each response'. That implies a terminal command producing successive model responses, which fits an interactive chat mode, but no chat command is named or described. The other CLI evidence covers only the API server and benchmarks. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a terminal chat command, description of the multi-turn interactive session, usage examples, independent or hands-on corroboration.
